notes.title: Enhanced Memory Window Creation Style and Explanations of "Memory" and "Object"
Hand-Reaching Effects, Linear & Bezier Connection Lines, and More
notes.content:
🎮 [b]Programming Simulator: New Update is Live![/b] 🚀

😊 We are excited to introduce the following new features:

🖐 [b]Connection Point Hand Interaction Effect[/b]
- When you drag a connection point, the target connection point will dynamically extend a hand 🖐 to interact with the dragged connection point.
- This effect enhances the intuitiveness and fun of the operation, making node connections smoother and more natural!

🐱 [b]Adorable Interaction Hint[/b]
- When dragging a connection point, an adorable cat 🐱 will pop up above all connectable nodes, playfully telling you "What I can do."
- This feature makes the connection process more intuitive and fun, helping you quickly understand the functionality of each node!

📏 [b]New Connection Line Styles[/b]
- Two connection line styles are now supported:
  - [b]Linear Line[/b]: The default style, simple and intuitive.
  - [b]Bezier Curve[/b]: Smooth and elegant, ideal for complex connection scenarios.
- You can freely switch between these styles in the settings panel.

📖 [b]Node Explanation Button[/b]
- A new explanation button ℹ️ has been added to the top-left corner of each node.
- Click the button to view detailed descriptions of the node's functionality, helping you better understand and use each node.

🎨 [b]Game Name Update[/b]
- To better reflect the core gameplay, we have renamed the game to [b]"Programming Simulator"[/b].
- We hope this change will help you better understand the theme and content of the game.

⚙️ [b]Settings Panel Support[/b]
- All new features (hand interaction effect, adorable interaction hint, connection line styles, node explanation button) can be enabled or disabled in the settings panel, allowing you to customize your experience.

❤️ Thank you for your support! If you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to contact us!
